purpose: AIM DEPOT night sky (Task 101) — replaces the Task-100 canvas-painted moon/stars
origin: GLB models supplied by the game owner (uploaded 2026-10-24, Sketchfab exports)

files.moon.bin: moon.glb raw accessor slices: f32 pos[3223] + f32 norm[3223] + f32 uv[3223] + u32 idx[17664] — unit sphere, engine scales x12
files.moon_diffuse.jpg: extracted from moon.glb (KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness diffuseTexture — the extension three r166+ GLTFLoader no longer parses, hence the extraction)
files.stars-night.bin: star_cluster_-_15k_stars_model.glb converted to camera-facing points: u32 nBuckets, then per bucket {u32 count, f32 size, count*(f32 pos[3]+f32 col[3])}; quad centers normalized onto the 285-330 dome (below-horizon stars culled); sizes/colors derived from quad edge length + per-mesh emissive tints (desaturated 55%)
files.star-sprite.png: extracted from the star cluster GLB (soft radial glow, black = zero emission for additive blending)

note: License is whatever the Sketchfab source listings state — supplied by the repo owner for this game. Do not claim CC0 here.
